Zoho Implementation Business Requirement

1. Our Requirement
We are using Zoho One and need complete implementation, customization and practical training for our event management business.

2. Zoho CRM
- Lead automatic creation and BDM assignment
- Duplicate company management
- Same company with multiple locations
- Multiple contacts under one company/location
- Event-wise and batch-wise data management
- Existing CRM data cleansing
- CRM automation and follow-up

3. Zoho Marketing Automation,campaign
- Email Campaign
- WhatsApp Campaign
- SMS Campaign
- Marketing Journey
- Audience Segmentation
- Follow-up Automation
- Campaign Tracking

4. Zoho Projects - Full Implementation
- Event-wise project setup
- Task and milestone management
- Task assignment
- Planned vs Actual Hours
- Billable / Non-billable
- Timesheet and Work Notes
- Automation
- Dashboard and Reports
- Team training

5. Zoho Creator ,Backstages Full Implementation
We have not started Zoho Creator yet. We need your recommendation and complete implementation for our event management requirements, including:
- Custom Applications
- Event Management
- Custom Forms
- Workflows
- CRM Integration
- Reports
- Dashboard
- User Roles

6. Zoho Analytics - Full Implementation
- CRM Dashboard
- BDM Performance
- Lead Analysis
- Event-wise Reports
- Marketing Campaign Reports
- Zoho Projects Reports
- Planned vs Actual Hours
- Team Performance
- Management Dashboard
- CRM / Projects / Marketing data integration

7. Training
We require practical training for:
- Zoho CRM
- Zoho Marketing Automation
- Zoho Projects
- Zoho Creator
- Zoho Analytics
- Automation and Reports

8. Cost Proposal Required
Please provide separate implementation cost for:
1. Zoho CRM
2. Zoho Marketing Automation
3. Zoho Projects - Full Implementation
4. Zoho Creator - Full Implementation
5. Zoho Analytics - Full Implementation
6. Integration / Customization
7. WhatsApp & SMS Integration

9. Training
10. Post-Implementation Support
11. Additional License / Add-on Cost
Please also provide the implementation timeline, scope, training plan and support details.

Main Objective
We want one integrated system for:
CRM + Marketing Automation + Projects + Creator + Analytics + Event Management + Email + WhatsApp + SMS
